posts.title: The source is out there
posts.description: Wow, October passed faster than September. Time runs faster when you have fun. Anyway, Stiva , the read-it-later app I'm building, sold for the first time, and the counter is at €40. posts.title: One tool to rule them all
posts.description: Last month I spent some time reorganizing my projects. I used to keep everything in Notion: one single database with tasks from every project, all tagged. I ran the ICE framework in there, the backlog, the Kanban board. It was convenient because I could update it from anywhere, online.
